title: HDF Component Primitives
description: First-class system component with identity, polymorphic type, generalized BOM attachment (boms[]), and system-binding properties. Components are the successor to Targets, adding stable identity (componentId), external system cross-references, and manifest inventory (SBOM, AI model/dataset, and reserved future BOM kinds).

type.title: Target Type
type.description: Component type discriminator. Same values as Target types, plus aiModel and dataset (thin AI subject components whose detail lives in an attached ai-model / dataset BOM).

componentId.description: Stable UUID (RFC 4122) for this component. Required in hdf-system documents, optional in hdf-results. Enables cross-document correlation, diffing, and data flow references.

description.description: Description of this component's role or purpose.

owner.description: Team or individual responsible for this component. Enables per-component ownership when different teams manage different parts of a system.

externalIds.description: Map of external identifier scheme to value. Well-known schemes: aws (instance ID), azure (resource ID), cmdb (asset ID), emass (system ID), cve (CVE ID). Custom schemes are allowed.

labels.description: Optional key-value labels for flexible grouping. Well-known keys: system, component, environment, region, team. Values must be strings.

boms.description: Component-scoped Bills of Materials (SBOM, ai-model, dataset, or any reserved bomType), each carried by passthrough (ref/document) or normalized. Replaces the former sbom/sbomRef/sbomFormat trio; a component may carry several BOMs (e.g. an SBOM plus an ai-model BOM). See primitives/bom.schema.json.

integrity.description: Cryptographic integrity of this component's underlying artifact — model weights or shards, dataset archive, container image, or package bytes. An array supports multi-file/sharded artifacts. This is the single, generic home for artifact/subject integrity across all component types (it replaced the former per-type Container_Image digest and Artifact checksum fields). Distinct from BOM-document integrity (Bom.hashes[]) and from the document tamper-evidence Integrity type.

baselineRefs.description: Names of baselines that apply to this component.

inputOverrides.description: System-specific overrides for baseline input values.

targetSelector.description: Label selector to match targets belonging to this component during migration. Targets with matching labels are automatically included.

Base_Component.description: Base properties shared by all component types. Extends the Target concept with stable identity, external references, generalized BOM attachment (boms[]), and unified artifact integrity (integrity[]).
Base_Component.title: Base Component

Component.description: A system component. Uses discriminated union pattern with 'type' field as discriminator. Superset of Target with identity, external IDs, and SBOM support.
Component.title: Component

hostname.description: Short, OS-reported host name (the unqualified machine name, e.g. 'web01'). Kept distinct from 'fqdn' because an FQDN is not reliably decomposable into hostname + domain (standalone/workgroup hosts have no domain; a directory domain is not the FQDN's DNS suffix). Aligns with ECS host.hostname and DISA STIG CKL HOST_NAME. Store the short name the source reports; do not derive it from the FQDN.

fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name (e.g. 'web01.prod.example.com'). Distinct from 'hostname' (short) and 'domain' (directory domain). ECS recommends storing this lowercase; the schema does not enforce case so source fidelity is preserved on round-trip.

domain.description: Directory domain the host is a member of — Active Directory / NetBIOS / LDAP domain (ECS host.domain semantics), NOT necessarily the DNS suffix of the FQDN. A standalone or workgroup host has a hostname but no domain. Not derivable from the FQDN; populate only from a source that carries directory membership.

macAddress.description: MAC address in colon-separated hexadecimal format.

examples.$comment: Domain-joined host carrying all three identity fields separately: short hostname, FQDN, and the (distinct) directory domain. HOST_NAME and HOST_FQDN from a STIG checklist map here; note the AD domain differs from the FQDN's DNS suffix.
examples.name: web-server-prod-01

examples.$comment: Standalone/workgroup host: has a short hostname but no directory domain — 'domain' is omitted rather than fabricated from the FQDN suffix.
examples.name: kiosk-lab-07

Host_Component.description: A physical or virtual server, workstation, or network device.
Host_Component.title: Host Component

Container_Image_Component.description: A static container image (not running). Image integrity — formerly the 'digest' field — is expressed via the shared Base_Component.integrity array.
Container_Image_Component.title: Container Image Component

image.description: Image the container was started from.

namespace.description: Namespace within the cluster, if applicable.

Container_Platform_Component.description: A container orchestration platform (Kubernetes, OpenShift, ECS, etc.).
Container_Platform_Component.title: Container Platform Component

Cloud_Account_Component.description: A cloud provider account (AWS account, Azure subscription, GCP project).
Cloud_Account_Component.title: Cloud Account Component

region.description: Cloud region where the resource resides.

Cloud_Resource_Component.description: A specific cloud resource (EC2 instance, S3 bucket, Azure VM, etc.).
Cloud_Resource_Component.title: Cloud Resource Component

Application_Component.description: A running application or API (for DAST tools).
Application_Component.title: Application Component

Artifact_Component.description: A software artifact or dependency (for SCA tools). Package integrity — formerly the 'checksum' field — is expressed via the shared Base_Component.integrity array.
Artifact_Component.title: Artifact Component

Network_Component.description: A network segment or network device.
Network_Component.title: Network Component

modelId.description: Provider/registry identifier for the model. Examples: a Hugging Face repo id ('meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf') or a model purl. Correlates the component to its ai-model BOM(s) and to lineage references from other models.

version.description: Model version, revision, or checkpoint tag.

AI_Model_Component.description: A thin AI-model component: identity and correlation only (parallel to Host_Component's fqdn/ip). All model detail — architecture, parameter count, serialization format, lineage — lives in an attached ai-model BOM (boms[]), never on the component itself.
AI_Model_Component.title: AI Model Component

datasetId.description: Provider/registry identifier for the dataset. Examples: a Hugging Face dataset repo id ('HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k'), a DOI, or a dataset purl. Correlates the component to its dataset BOM(s) and to datasetRefs from ai-model components.

version.description: Dataset version, release identifier, or — for highly dynamic datasets — a timestamped release marker.

Dataset_Component.description: A thin dataset component: identity and correlation only, symmetric with AI_Model_Component. All dataset detail — record count, format, classification, lineage — lives in an attached dataset BOM (boms[]), never on the component itself.
Dataset_Component.title: Dataset Component
